notes: Written from the guide's 'Game plan by turn' and 'Playbook seeds'.
goFirst: strategy-concepts §10 [S17] 'the general default is to go second'; the guide gives no seat advice, only a DON!! table for both seats [SH-PEN] (inference).

weights.don 0.6: 'You spend DON!! to draw, and get it back for free' [SH-PEN]; almost every card pays DON!! -1 or -2 and the DON!! Phase and the leader refill it, so a spent DON!! is cheap. Inference: the DON!! term counts for less. weights.hand 1.1: 'how many cards can I draw before I commit' [SH-PEN].

cardValue: Enel OP15-118 is the finisher (immune to opposing effects with 6 or less DON!!, +2000) [CARD][SH-ENC]; Holly gives Double Attack to every Ohm [CARD][SH-PEN]; Shura always has Rush under this leader [CARD]. Every number is an inference.
faceBias 1.0/1.05/1.15: a tempo deck whose plan ends with the 14000 finisher [SH-ENC]; inference: more weight on the opponent's Life late.

mulligan: the sourced rule 'hands with no 1-cost Character' [SH-PEN] goes back, going first or second; the guide's 'another 1-drop, a 0-cost event, Law or Holly' keepable hand is an inference and is not used to redraw.

seed 1/2: 'activate' (the leader's surge from T2), 'targetCanAttack' (its DON!! go to a Character that can attack) and 'attackWith' on any Character carrying 3 or more given DON!! (the loaded Character swings).
seed 3: 'play' bias on the 1-cost Characters by T1 [SH-PEN]. seed 4: 'acceptOptional' on the DON!! -1 draw of Ohm, Shura and Satori [SH-PEN]. seed 5: 'attackWith' OP15-118 [SH-ENC].
Citations are what 'Why?' shows when a move follows the line; every bias here has a public condition.

assertions.text: Activates the leader on every turn from T2 in at least 95% of turns where it is legal.
Gives the leader's rested DON!! to a Character that attacks in the same turn in at least 80% of activations where such a Character exists.
Plays a 1-cost Character on T1 when one is in hand in at least 90% of games.
